title: Set-aside buffer downgraded 25% -> 10% on replacement strategies: deploy script pins the intent doc's stale figure, contradicting the user-specified 25% set by replace-sya on the live strategies two days earlier
description: The intent doc (2026-06-12) claims 'the live original staker has a 10% set-aside buffer configured' and the script hardcodes SETASIDE_BUFFER=10 with a require pinning it. But ReplaceSYAMainnet (broadcast 2026-06-10) set STAKER_BUFFER_PERCENT=25 on all three live strategies, annotated 'USER-SPECIFIED 2026-06-10: 25%' — i.e. 10% was the pre-replace-sya value and 25% is the current deliberate choice. Verified on fork: old DOLA and USDC strategies both return setAsideBufferSize(staker)==25. The replacement strategies silently revert the staker's below-par insulation to 10% with no recorded rationale. Non-obvious owner footgun: the operator believes they are preserving existing protection while actually reducing it by 60%.
impact: Stakers' set-aside reserve against below-par dips is 10% of skimmed surplus instead of the currently-chosen 25%. Moot until YS-03 is fixed (no skims reach the new strategies at all), which compounds the configuration debt.

classification.assetImpact: No direct loss. Stakers' set-aside reserve against below-par dips is silently set to 10% of skimmed surplus instead of the user-specified 25% chosen two days earlier — a 60% reduction in below-par insulation.
attackPath: 1. Intent doc claims live staker has 10% buffer; script hardcodes SETASIDE_BUFFER=10 with a pinning require.
2. ReplaceSYAMainnet had set 25% ('USER-SPECIFIED 2026-06-10') on all three live strategies.
3. V2 strategies silently revert to 10%; operator believes they are preserving protection.
classification.likelihood: Deterministic config; moot until YS-03 is fixed (no skims reach V2 strategies).
classification.assumptions: Non-obvious footgun — operator surprised they reduced rather than preserved the buffer.
classification.externalRequirements: Owner confirmation of intended buffer; one-value fix.

evidence: Fork reads: setAsideBufferSize(staker)==25 on 0x90ce…7F9 and 0x90af…470; ==10 on ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2 after this script. ReplaceSYAMainnet.s.sol:132-136 comments. Intent doc 'Set-Aside Buffer' section. side-effects.json clusterChecks[2].
recommendation: Confirm the intended buffer with the owner; if 25% stands, change SETASIDE_BUFFER to 25 and source the value from the replace-sya decision in a comment. Update the stale figure in the intent doc.
dedupNotes: Sole source: deploy F4 (idx3). Distinct root cause (StaleConfigValue). Standalone Low.
